findings.claim: A commit whose Risk trailer fails is still read for its role records (commitFacts falls through to readRoles). A sweep record that cannot be read, or that does not hold, will then fail with that record's error. The spec says the first thing a commit lacks is reported, in this order, with the trailer first. For such a commit the trailer error would be hidden behind the sweep-record error. The comment says it is read for its sweep only, but the code does not stop at the trailer error. Only the case of a trailer error combined with a corrupt sweep record is affected. Needs would return the trailer error first if readRoles were skipped on a RiskErr. The sweep is only needed to decide whether to add the second item.
